newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds lower, but buyers hold back.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds lower, but buyers hold back.

text.p: Lower Chicago futures at the end of last week triggered falls of as much as four stg a tonne in soymeal prices on the UK meals and feeds market during Monday.
However, buyers were holding back for lower prices.
"What we need is for the Chicago market to appear to be on the turn and that will fetch the buyers in," said one trader.
"Some buyers are congratulating themselves on holding out for so long, but I feel that if they don't buy soon the market is going to kick them where it hurts," said another trader.
So far brokers have only reported one trade when a small load of high protein soymeal fetched 196 stg for spot on the east coast.
